title: Track Our Progress: The Official Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap provides a transparent, easy-to-follow overview of our recently shipped features, current developments, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've significantly upgraded your interactive experience with checkboxes that are now easier to click, seamlessly draggable, and beautifully updated to match our modern design.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded our collaborative editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work alongside your team in real-time.

title: Ultimate File Control in Editor
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage all your embedded files, including new capabilities to upload, link, remove, download, and tailor their visual presentation directly within the editor.

title: Advanced Search and Filtering
summary: This upcoming feature will transform how you explore your knowledge by introducing powerful filtering, sorting, and collection-saving tools.

title: Smarter Content Connections
summary: Unlock new levels of clarity and organization with enhanced content connections that adapt to your unique thinking style.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Noeko is launching with new self-hosting options, empowering you to host your data privately and access powerful premium features through flexible plans, including a free community edition.

title: Discover Your Perfect Look: New Themes & Refinements
summary: We're enhancing our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new styles to give you more ways to personalize your experience.
